# Everything else: seq, printf, echo, test, expr, factor, tsort, yes, true,
# false, env, printenv, date, sleep, split, csplit, shuf, tee, truncate,
# mktemp, xargs, nproc-free checks.

seq 5
seq 2 3 11
seq -s, 1 5
seq -w 8 11
seq 1 0.5 3
seq -f '%.2f' 1 3
seq 5 1
seq 0
seq 1 x
env printf '%s-%d\n' a 1 b 2
env printf '%5.2f|%-4s|%x\n' 3.14159 ab 255
env printf '%b' 'a\tb\n'
env printf '%q\n' "it's"
env printf '%d\n' x
env printf '%c%c\n' hello world
env echo -n no newline
env echo -e 'a\tb'
env echo hello world
env test -f a.txt; echo $?
env test -d a.txt; echo $?
env test 1 -lt 2 -a -n x; echo $?
env test 1 -eq x; echo $?
env test -l abc -eq 3; echo $?
env [ a = a ]; echo $?
env [ a = a; echo $?
expr 2 + 3 '*' 4
expr length hello
expr substr hello 2 3
expr index hello l
expr abc : 'a\(.*\)'
expr 5 / 0; echo $?
expr 1 = 2; echo $?
factor 12 97 1001
factor -h 360
env echo 18 x 7 | factor
tsort deps
env printf 'a b b a\n' | tsort
yes | head -n 3
yes a b | head -n 2
true; echo $?
false; echo $?
env -i A=1 B=2 /usr/bin/env
printenv HOME >/dev/null; echo $?
printenv NOPE; echo $?
date -d @0
date -u -d '2020-02-29 12:00' +%j-%A-%U
date -d @86400 '+%Y %m %d %H %M %S %s'
sleep 0.01; echo $?
sleep x
split -l 1 a.txt && ls x*
split -b 4 -d noeol p && ls p*
csplit -s a.txt 2 && cat xx00
shuf -i 1-5 --random-source=a.txt | sort -n
env echo hi | tee out && cat out
truncate -s 3 a.txt && cat a.txt
truncate -s +2 noeol && wc -c noeol
xargs < words
env printf '1\n2\n3\n' | xargs -n 2 echo
env printf 'a\0b\0' | xargs -0 echo
env echo a b c | xargs -I{} echo [{}]
xargs -n 0
arch | grep -c .
uname -s
